privileged_info_for_vlm: The page title must be exactly 'Classical Sessions EP'. There must be exactly 3 Audio blocks and 3 Details blocks. Each Details block summary must follow the pattern 'Track Notes: [Composer Name]'. The content must be sourced from ~/Music/Classical_EP/ep_assets.txt. The page status must be 'publish', not 'draft'.
